Your photo and the outfit image are uploaded to our try-on service only when you tap Generate, so an AI model can create the result. They are used for that request. Saved looks stay in this app\'s private storage on your device and are never uploaded, backed up to the cloud, or shared unless you choose Share.\n\nThis app contains no advertising and requests no storage, camera or contacts permissions. Photos come from the system photo picker, and the camera app only when you choose Camera.
